We Are Building the Future of Fintech

Tipalti is building the future of global finance automation. Across our offices, our talented people create, innovate, and optimize solutions that deliver customer value within the financial operations ecosystem. Our high-performing environment offers incredible opportunities for learning and collaboration. Connect with Tipalti today and learn how you can grow your career and provide value to a dynamic industry.

What We Stand For

Dedication to Customer Success

Strive to deliver excellence by putting customers first.

Grow Our Talent

Hire top talent and drive their career progression. Promote from within.

GSD

Have a bias for action, focus on being impactful, and make fast decisions.

Innovate & Embrace Change

Continually optimize and improve, take risks, adapt quickly, and make courageous decisions.

Ownership Mentality

Value company resources, communicate openly, collaborate as equals, and drive the best outcomes for Tipalti.

Why Join Us?

We Win as One

At Tipalti, community and collaboration are at the heart of our business. 
We hire people who are exceptional at what they do but are humble and invested in each other’s success. Winning feels sweeter when you do it with Tipaltians.

We Impact an Industry

We take pride in the quality of our product and the impact that it has.
Whether you pitch Tipalti to clients, implement a solution or drive product development, you’ll quickly become familiar with the ‘lightbulb moment’ clients experience with Tipalti.

We Provide Opportunities

At Tipalti, amazing opportunities exist for those who seek them.
You’ll be consistently provided with the opportunity to learn new things and empowered to take ownership regardless of your background or place within the organization.

We Build Lasting Connections

At Tipalti, we build long-term partnerships. 
Evidenced by our 99% customer retention rate, you’ll build lasting connections with customers and colleagues and come to think of many of them as friends.

Locations

Where We Work

North and South American Offices

Foster City, United States

Our corporate HQ features an amazing panoramic view of the bay, from San Francisco to San Jose, that is truly spectacular. Featuring a spacious cafe, playful bistro/game room, library retreat, complimentary gym membership, and award-winning design, this office truly inspires the team’s success.

Plano, United States

Our Plano team is located at the Legacy Town Center amongst a wealth of amenities that complement an ideal location. It’s fair to say that Texas hospitality is a point of pride for our Plano team, who thrive in an open work environment that emphasizes collaboration. Enjoy free access to the on-site gym and weekly events to celebrate, educate, or simply have fun.

Vancouver, Canada

The beauty of our award-winning Vancouver office is only rivaled by the natural beauty of Vancouver itself, where we take full advantage of the views from the upper floors of Bentall Centre. Our office can be easily accessed from the Burrard subway stop right outside and is a short walk to Vancouver Harbour. There is an abundance of amenities only steps away from the office—plus, we’re dog-friendly!

Toronto, Canada

Our downtown Toronto office is a short walk from Union Station. The office embraces the energy that is so abundant in Canada’s largest city, including a regular schedule of events and lunch served daily from local restaurants. 

Medellín, Colombia

Our rapidly growing office in Medellin is home to approximately 60 team members across customer support, people, compliance, onboarding, sales, marketing, and finance. Located in the Select Building in El Poblado, one of Medellín’s most desirable neighborhoods, our space offers breathtaking 360° views of the city and the surrounding mountains.

Europe and Asia Offices

London, United Kingdom

Our central London office is located just minutes away from the London Stock Exchange and St. Paul’s Cathedral, in the heart of the City. Our close-knit London team is proud of its diversity and has representation from all our functions.

Amsterdam, The Netherlands

Easily accessed from Amsterdam Centraal station, we’re located at Spaces DeWalvis at the Westerdok, where we’ve established our home for EU expansion. Amsterdam is our youngest office, but we’re growing very quickly as our European business continues to gain momentum.

Tbilisi, Georgia

Our Tbilisi office is situated centrally in the city’s finance district within the Axis Towers complex. It is accessible by public transport and is only a short walk from cafes, restaurants, and Vake Park. The Tbilisi office has seen significant growth in recent months and our team members based in Georgia cover sales, finance, product, engineering, marketing, operations, and customer support.

Tel Aviv, Israel

Tel Aviv is our largest office with over 350 Tipalti team members located in the northern part of the city in a newly constructed building that is the pride of the neighborhood. We enjoy sensational views in almost every direction from our rooftop retreat and expansive balcony garden adjacent to our cafe. A variety of lunch options are provided daily, and there is a gym located right inside the building.

Culture and Benefits

A hybrid work model

Our hybrid work model allows you the flexibility to directly engage with your colleagues in-person, as well as the opportunity to work away from the office.

Competitive compensation and workplace benefits

We pride ourselves on rewarding our people. As a pre-IPO company, we provide employees with competitive compensation and equity packages that give you a vested interest in our future success. 

Events to energize you

From softball to pilates to race karting evenings, you’ll have no trouble finding an event or activity where you can connect with your colleagues and form lasting friendships.

Collaborative Work Spaces

As we’ve grown, we’ve invested in new offices that allow you to collaborate across teams and functions. When you’re looking to unwind, you won’t be short of cafes, libraries, or other community spaces within your workplace environment.

Unique Opportunities to Drive Your Professional Growth

At Tipalti, we are all about providing resources to help you reach your full potential. You’ll grow your mind, develop new skills, and encounter constant opportunities to learn something new.

An Inclusive Community

We believe that the strongest teams are ones in which everyone has a voice, irrespective of their background or position within the organization. Our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), such as #intheblack, #tipaltiaspire, #tipalticaregivers, #rainbowroom, and #women_at_tipalti offer community platforms to educate, support, and champion causes that matter.

Global Opportunities and Exposure

At Tipalti, you’ll never be short of opportunities to partner with colleagues from across the world. Our teams work together to deliver impact on a global scale—which is only getting bigger.

Authentic Colleagues

At our core, we are humble and authentic. Our people are genuine—what you see is what you get. Some days might be more challenging than others, but with good people at your side, you’ll always be supported.

Autonomy To Get Stuff Done

At Tipalti, we get things done, and we want to provide you with the autonomy to drive significant change and innovation.
